details.completeness_justification: The candidate summary adequately covers the core material meaning of K1, K2, K3, K4, K5, K6, K8, and K9. K1 is fully covered with revenue, EBITDA, net profit, and portfolio growth. K2 is covered with the revenue breakdown across product lines. K3 is covered with the introduction of installment loans in European markets. K4 is covered with smartphone financing in Kenya and Uganda. K5 is covered with the expansion into Tanzania. K6 is covered with the pilot implementation of AI voice agents. K8 is covered with the refinancing and issuance of bonds. K9 is covered with the distribution of dividends. However, K7 (bond tap completion), K10 (impairment expense), K11 (regulatory challenge in Moldova), and K12 (post-reporting period funding) are missing entirely, leading to a 'Generally yes' score due to significant omissions in HIGH-importance items.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is fully coherent internally. All statements logically support the overall narrative of financial growth and strategic expansion. There are no self-contradictions: revenue growth (S2) aligns with segment performance descriptions (S2-S3), profitability metrics (S4-S5) show consistent improvement trends, and strategic initiatives (S8-S9) directly support the reported growth figures. The organizational flow moves logically from financial highlights to operational drivers and future outlook. No unnecessary repetition occurs, and all components work together to form a unified narrative without internal inconsistencies.
